questions.prompt: What is the yesterday of tomorrow and the tomorrow of yesterday?
questions.explanation: Yesterday of tomorrow / tomorrow of yesterday = today.

questions.prompt: What type of meat can be found in the word SHAMPOO?
questions.explanation: Look inside the letters of SHAMPOO — HAM.

questions.prompt: If a young cat is written as KTTN, how would a young dog be written?
questions.explanation: KTTN is kitten without vowels; puppy without vowels is PPPY.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT an anagram of a colour? SLIVER, LUBE, GENRE, RIPPLE
accepted: r i p p l e
questions.explanation: SLIVER→silver, LUBE→blue, GENRE→green; RIPPLE is not a colour anagram.

questions.prompt:
Gloria is playing a game of two truths and one lie. Which statement is the lie?
A) I was born when my parents’ ages both contained the numbers 2 and 3
B) When I turned 18, my mother was 50 and my father was 41
C) My parents were both born on 29th February, 11 years apart
accepted: My parents were both born on 29th February, 11 years apart
questions.explanation: C is impossible: leap-day birthdays 11 years apart can’t both be 29 Feb under the calendar rules implied.

questions.prompt:
What single letter replaces the question marks to create three real words?
?AYA?
?IOS?
?NOC?
Edna’s birthday is on the sixth of April and Jen’s birthday falls on the 15th of October, therefore Amir’s birthday must be the ‘?’ of January.
questions.explanation: Dates as day numbers: 6 Apr + 15 Oct pattern → Amir is the 24th of January.

questions.prompt: What four-letter word replaces the missing part of this sentence? ‘Mr Owl ate my metal ____’
questions.explanation: Palindrome sentence: “Mr Owl ate my metal worm.”

questions.prompt:
Which of these would it be impossible to do?
A) Marry your cousin’s cousin
B) Marry your brother’s widow
C) Marry your widow’s sister
questions.explanation: C is impossible — if you have a widow, you’re dead and can’t marry.

questions.prompt: What is the first number in English that, when spelled out, has its letters in alphabetical order?

Jamaica + Japan = 124
Argentina + Armenia = 1245
France + Brazil = 23
England + Germany = ?
questions.explanation: Sum the FIFA World Cup wins of each country pair → England+Germany = 56.

questions.prompt: Last month was not May or July. Next month is not January, March, or November. Neither last month nor next month is April, August, or December. What month must it be?
questions.explanation: Work through the constraints month-by-month; only April fits.

questions.prompt:
What four-word phrase can you get if you keep everything below, but remove “two letters” in order?
T I W O A M L A W E T I N T E N R E S R
questions.explanation: Remove the letters T-W-O-L-E-T-T-E-R-S in order; leftover spells I AM A WINNER.

questions.prompt:
What letter completes this sequence?
S M H D W M ?
questions.explanation: Second, Minute, Hour, Day, Week, Month, Year → Y.

questions.prompt: I wanted to spell with my spoonful of alphabet soup. What’s the longest word I could create using the letters in the spoon as many times as I want?
questions.explanation: Longest word from alphabet-soup letters (unlimited reuse of those glyphs): INCONVENIENCED.
